children: NOVO_B: Phase 3 data show next-gen obesity drug achieved ~12.4% average weight loss and outperformed Eli Lilly’s rival in trial-stage efficacy comparison.
EMA recommended approval in May for Novo Nordisk’s oral Wegovy, advancing potential EU launch of an oral alternative to the Wegovy injection for Novo Nordisk A/S Sponsored ADR Class B (NOVO_B).
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) cut ~13,000 jobs to ~66,000 and targets >10bn DKK in savings to boost commercial efforts, R&D and expand manufacturing for oral GLP‑1 obesity drugs.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) says competition in obesity drugs has intensified, rivals like Eli Lilly lead; company will fight for semaglutide volume and notes potential sales hit from generics.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) plans a multi-year obesity drug rollout: CagriSema combo launching early next year, standalone cagrilintide after, high‑dose CagriSema in 2028, then zenagamtide progress.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) said it aims to have at least five oral therapy candidates in clinical trials by year-end, accelerating its oral-drug pipeline and trial start timing.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) began a buyback under Safe Harbour on 6 May 2026: repurchases of B shares up to DKK 11.2bn through 1 Feb 2027, within a DKK 15bn 12‑month program.
NOVO_B shares slid after investor day; bank said strategy seems sound but unimpressive, wants concrete clinical/commercial evidence, sees uncertain growth and limited near‑term catalysts.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B): management flags CagriSema as a key 2027 launch and says it favors bolt‑on M&A but won’t rule out larger deals.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) reported promising initial data on painful diabetic neuropathy in type 2 diabetes at an event; detailed results to be released later.
